trust_decision.summary: Whether a build may send telemetry (authenticated with a token, carrying a fingerprint digest of env vars, CLI args and config file) is decided by a compiled-in default token plus an env opt-out; at the pinned commit the default is a hardcoded "secret" and an empty token still sends.

landing_point.why: The summary names a hardcoded authentication token; the literal "secret" default lives here. Release workflows already inject -X telemetry.auth, which does not match the var name authToken, so release builds ship "secret".

fix_sites.entry_point: public API telemetry.NewTracker (called from cli/cli.go:319); fix adds an empty-token early return, an enabled field and an Enabled() method (fix.diff:75-97)
Runner.Run -> runNode for the anycable-go CLI and embedded runners using cli.WithTelemetry() (cmd/embedded-cable/main.go:24)
Metrics.Run (unrelated to the advisory: removes a comment and adds defer close(serverErr), fix.diff:33-41)
fix_sites.module_kind: unrelated metrics change bundled in the commit

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: telemetry/telemetry.go:56 (NewTracker must disable itself when the token is empty; the published fix adds this at fix.diff:76-78 and gates cli/cli.go:318-325 on Enabled())

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Emptying the hardcoded default looks sufficient, and Send already handles a token-less run by skipping the Authorization header (telemetry/telemetry.go:145-147). A solver can read that as supported unauthenticated sending and leave NewTracker and the runner gate alone, so telemetry, including the secret-derived fingerprint, is still sent.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: When a token is supplied (build-time -X or set on Config), telemetry must still send boot/usage events with the Authorization header, honour ANYCABLE_TELEMETRY_URL and custom props, and keep ANYCABLE_DISABLE_TELEMETRY as an opt-out. Deleting telemetry or always disabling it breaks TestTracking and the dev setup in the Makefile.

O6_input_shapes: default build with no token (empty string after fix)
Config.Token set programmatically on telemetry.Config before NewTracker

O7_producer.where: telemetry/telemetry.go:320-347 clusterFingerprint (reads ANYCABLE* env vars at telemetry/telemetry.go:386-399, os.Args at telemetry/telemetry.go:402-407, and the config file contents at telemetry/telemetry.go:410-421) and sends the result as cluster-fingerprint at telemetry/telemetry.go:125

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The cluster fingerprint is an unsalted SHA-256 over ANYCABLE* env vars, raw CLI args (e.g. --secret) and full config file contents, sent with every event. The fix does not touch it, so token-enabled builds still transmit secret-derived data.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a one-way hash used only as an anonymous cluster ID, and the fix only addressed the hardcoded token; docs/telemetry.md:23 says env vars are not collected, which a solver can treat as already satisfied by hashing.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the NewTracker site, about 260 lines below the constructor; reached only through NewTracker -> clusterFingerprint

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second opt-in/opt-out route (e.g. a CLI flag or config-file key enabling telemetry) that builds Config with its own default token, bypassing NewConfig.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Telemetry is configured by env in WithTelemetry only; adding a --telemetry flag in cli/options.go with its own Config literal is a natural maintainer extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An appProperties field that copies a raw config value (e.g. broker or RPC host string) next to the existing boolean feature flags.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Properties already include free-text adapter names (telemetry/telemetry.go:250-252), so adding a host or URL string would look routine.

O9_family: CWE-798 hard-coded credential plus CWE-312 sensitive data leaving the process via telemetry (opt-out default / secret-derived payload)

O10_build.project_tests: telemetry/telemetry_test.go:34-93 TestTracking uses httptest and needs no network; cli/cli_test.go exists (telemetry coverage there not checked)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change the default token in telemetry/config.go to "" (or fix the ldflags name) and stop, leaving token-less telemetry sending through Send's existing empty-token branch.

out_of_scope_notes: anycableCLIArgs sorts os.Args[1:] in place, mutating the process-global argument slice (telemetry/telemetry.go:403-404).
The bundled metrics change adds defer close(serverErr) while a server goroutine may still send on it (fix.diff:33, metrics/metrics.go:135-141); unrelated to the advisory.
After the fix, a zero-value Tracker returned for an empty token has nil logger/client, so calling Collect without checking Enabled() would panic (fix.diff:76-78).

The expected fix for the O8 fingerprint route is underdetermined (drop args/env/file, salt, or exclude secret keys); hidden tests there need a precise report statement to stay fair.
The published fix adds a new Enabled() API; behavioural tests must avoid depending on that exact name unless the report states it, or must check no HTTP request when the token is empty.

defence_ineffective=1 reflects the ldflags mismatch: workflows inject telemetry.auth (.github/workflows/release-binaries.yml:48) but the var is authToken (telemetry/config.go:12), so the intended build-time override never took effect.
